title: Get Maximum in Generated Array
summary: Given an integer n, an array nums of length n+1 is created with initial values nums[0]=0 and nums[1]=1.
statement: Given an integer n, an array nums of length n+1 is created with initial values nums[0]=0 and nums[1]=1. For indices i, nums[2*i] equals nums[i], and nums[2*i+1] equals nums[i]+nums[i+1]. The task is to find the highest number in this array.
constraints: Construct indices 0 through n by the stated even and odd recurrences and return their maximum.
hints: Each new value depends only on already generated smaller indices.
Allocate n+1 values and fill them in increasing index order.
Copy nums[i//2] at even i; add nums[i//2] and nums[i//2+1] at odd i; track the maximum.
Both parent indices are smaller than i, so forward construction satisfies every recurrence exactly once.
editorial: Both parent indices are smaller than i, so forward construction satisfies every recurrence exactly once.

tests.explanation: The generated values 0,1,1,2,1,3,2,3 have maximum three.
Only nums[0]=0 exists, so the maximum is zero.
